productArea.name: Wiki
productArea.scope: Find, create, edit, and delete wiki pages using page navigation, content search, revision history, comparisons, and diff downloads. Repository code, issue discussions, and enabling the Wiki unit in repository settings are outside this area.

entryPoints.directions: Choose Wiki in the seeded repository and use its page navigation, content search, editing, and history controls. Enable Wiki in a disposable repository only as a prerequisite if needed.
